biotools.summary: TOM500 is a comprehensive, multi-organ annotated orbital MRI dataset of 500 patients with thyroid eye disease (TED), providing T2-weighted MRI scans, clinical data, and expert-annotated segmentations of nine orbital structures. The dataset facilitates the development of advanced computational tools for TED diagnosis and observation.
